notes: Customer profile: multi-tenant contact center SaaS for mid-enterprise and telco customers; peak-oriented (holiday campaigns, outages).
Primary pain: unpredictable per-token costs and degraded agent-assist latency during incident bursts; queue backpressure cascades -> SLA misses.
SRE concerns: tail latency at 99.9th pct, cold-starts for large models after scale-up, autoscaling sensitivity to short spikes.
Business: margins hit by high token spend during seasonal peaks; reimbursements to large customers when SLA missed.
Technical ask: guaranteed 95th pct < 200ms for short assistant responses (prompt+response < 4k tokens), burst headroom for 8x baseline for 15 minutes.
Routing needs: priority routing for paid customers, automatic fallback to cheaper model for low-priority queues, model pinning per tenant.
Feature asks: tool-calling integration (create ticket, add internal note) from assistant; audit trail for each generated action; ability to replay KV cache warmup.
Quote from Head of SRE: "We need deterministic behavior under backpressure — not statistical hope. If the model spikes, we need graceful degradation paths."
POC metrics requested: per-route latency P99, token cost per 1M requests, cache hit rate, time-to-warm KV cache, failover time to fallback model.
Requested artifacts: security FAQ, dedicated sizing recommendations, example canary policy for region spillover (drive link shared).
SE notes: propose Redwood Dedicated with pre-warmed pools + automatic small-model fallback + prefix caching; test plan: traffic replay of Dec 2025 peak and 8x synthetic burst.
CS notes: account likely to convert if POC proves <2x cost uplift at peak vs baseline and maintains SLA with fallback enabled.
